items.text: Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to ankle injury sustained in first half vs Bucs.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; check Week 4 status.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison and TE volume spike in MIN pass game.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off and ruled out with rib injury/strain vs Cardinals; full eval Monday.
items.why: Hard hit, carted, rib strain confirmed.
items.opportunity: Other SF WRs/TE elevate in remaining snaps.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury late vs Lions.
items.why: Thigh injury after tackle, ruled out.
items.implication: Sit; handcuff elevation for remainder and possibly next week.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs Chiefs with knee injury; coach Jeff Hafley not optimistic, sounds like major concern per Rapoport.
items.why: Knee injury early, evaluated, shut down; coach major concern.
items.implication: Sit immediately; monitor for multi-week absence.
items.opportunity: MIA RB committee/backups elevate for residual work.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout looked good on hamstring; was true GTD with team not counting on him.
items.why: Pregame workout successful; Schefter confirmed active.
items.implication: Startable if rostered; targets may be managed/pitch count.
items.opportunity: Primary WR roleopens; Bateman/Andrews volume decreases from OUT assumption.

items.text: Bears expected to start Case Keenum at QB vs Eagles; Caleb Williams ruled out with Grade 2 hamstring (3-4 week timeline).
items.why: Grade 2 hamstring, 3-4 weeks; Bagent limited practice, Keenum starts.
items.implication: Williams stash only; CHI pass catchers downgrade with Keenum.
items.opportunity: Limited for CHI skill players under backup QB.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Achane (knee), Jefferson (ankle), Hall (quad), Etienne (hamstring), Evans (rib), Mayfield (thumb), Coker (quad), Andrews (hand), Spears (ankle), Bech (broken forearm IR).
items.why: Post-game comprehensive watch list aligning with Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Monitor all for Week 4; Bech to IR.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and depth chart risers for OUT players.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF vs Broncos.
items.opportunity: LAR WR depth (Adams etc.) volume up.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut vs Saints.
items.why: Cleared for debut after knee issue.
items.implication: Strong start candidate as featured TE.
items.opportunity: High target share expected in LV offense.

items.text: Zay Flowers active: risky but if active for Baltimore he's active for me. Start him over Bateman.
items.conflict: Levitan initial projs had him OUT.

items.text: AD Mitchell expected inactive (finger); Jets WR depth: Garrett Wilson clear WR1 then Isaiah Williams etc.; expect TE Kenyon Sadiq hybrid slot/wide snaps. High opportunity for Wilson.
items.why: Mitchell GTD to inactive; Wilson top of thin depth chart.
items.implication: Wilson massive target share boost vs DET.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets spike; Sadiq hybrid role.

items.text: Commanders expected to sign FA RB Austin Ekeler to 53-man roster pending physical; healed from Achilles, prior workout with Panthers.
items.implication: Potential WSH RB committee change; monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Pass-catching RB role possible behind or with current backs.

items.text: Trevor Lawrence knelt to set up Bhayshul Tuten rushing TD; Berry highlights #FantasyLife for Tuten support.
items.why: Coach/QB intentional support for fantasy-relevant TD.
items.opportunity: Increased carries near end zone in JAC.

items.text: ETR had Zay Flowers (hamstring) out in projections initially (late Bateman/Andrews DFS swap possible); Moore in but limited, Mitchell out. Updated with actives.
items.why: No early clarity; conservative OUT then late swap readiness.
items.implication: DFS pivot to Bateman/Andrews if Flowers scratches.
items.opportunity: Contingent volume to Ravens other pass-catchers.
